description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayHttpConfig class in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.gateway.util.config.endpoints package. It verifies behaviors such as immutability, equality, schema version handling, and configuration parsing for HTTP-related gateway settings.

classes.name: GatewayHttpConfigTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for GatewayHttpConfig, testing configuration behaviors and immutability.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test configuration by loading 'gateway-http-test' config file.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that GatewayHttpConfig and related collections are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Checks that the equals and hashCode methods are correctly implemented for GatewayHttpConfig.

methods.name: getSchemaVersionsReturnsDefaultIfNotSet
methods.description: Ensures default schema versions are returned when not explicitly configured.

methods.name: getDefaultSchemaVersions
methods.description: Helper method to extract default schema versions from configuration.

methods.name: getConfiguredSchemaVersions
methods.description: Verifies correct retrieval of configured schema versions.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithUnknownSchemaVersions
methods.description: Tests that an unknown schema version in configuration causes an appropriate exception.

methods.name: getQueryParametersAsHeadersReturnsDefaultIfNotSet
methods.description: Checks default query parameters as headers when not configured.

methods.name: getDefaultQueryParamsAsHeaders
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve default query headers.

methods.name: getConfiguredQueryParametersAsHeaders
methods.description: Verifies configured query parameters as headers are correctly parsed.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithUnknownQueryParametersAsHeaders
methods.description: Ensures that unknown header keys in configuration trigger an exception.

methods.name: underTestReturnsDefaultValuesIfBaseConfigWasEmpty
methods.description: Checks default media types are used when config is empty.

methods.name: testMultipleCommaSeparatedMediaTypes
methods.description: Tests parsing of multiple comma-separated media types in configuration.

methods.name: testNonParsableMediaType
methods.description: Tests handling of invalid media type strings.
